6.81 rsInvalidGroupExpressionScope
rsInvalidGroupExpressionScope is a critical error that will occur when a RowNumber aggregate
function within a GroupExpressions.GroupExpression element has its Scope parameter set to a value
that does not match the name of the Group that contains the current Group.
